verdict.rationale: Luma's evidence documents generative video and image capabilities and Agents that 'research, generate, and refine' creative assets. Nothing shows the product analyzing a user's own data to surface AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. Generating content is a different capability from deriving insights from user data, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
